_meta.description: Hand-maintained price reference for providers the upstream table does not cover. Same shape and units as reference-prices.json, but authored here and never overwritten by the generator.
_meta.authority: Neither file is the billing authority - model.model_price_rules is (ADR-004). These are review inputs for an operator setting a rule through /capability/price-rules.
_meta.units: inputUnitPrice / outputUnitPrice are per unitTokens, in the stated currency. unitTokens matches the model_price_rules default of 1000000.

entryShape.currency: ISO 4217, e.g. CNY or USD - record the currency the vendor actually bills in, do not pre-convert
entryShape.source: where the number came from - vendor pricing page URL and the date it was read

_meta.howToAdd: Copy the price from the vendor's own pricing console (not a third-party aggregator), add an entry keyed by the Atlas model_code, and cite it in `source`. Prices are money - a wrong entry here becomes a wrong bill.

upstreamGaps.finding: 12 upstream entries exist but all carry zero or absent input/output cost (measured 2026-08-01). Importing them would create rules that charge nothing.
upstreamGaps.action: Author entries here from the Volcengine Ark pricing console.

upstreamGaps.finding: No first-party Zhipu entries upstream at all. GLM models appear only under resellers (cerebras, cloudflare, deepinfra, fireworks_ai), whose prices are their own, not Zhipu's.
upstreamGaps.action: Author entries here from the BigModel pricing console.

upstreamGaps.finding: Unpriced upstream by definition - self-hosted models have no vendor price.
upstreamGaps.action: If private models need a chargeback rate, it is an internal cost allocation decision, not a vendor price. Author it here explicitly or leave the model without a price rule.
